versions.changelog:
Toutiao Publisher Skill 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Enables publishing articles to Toutiao (Today's Headlines) with persistent login and session management.
- Supports interactive login via browser and automated publishing with command-line arguments.
- Enforces Toutiao's title length requirements automatically during publishing.
- Includes commands for checking authentication status and logging out.
- Employs stealth techniques and manages its own virtual environment for reliability.
